unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM judge on a small set of physician-scored examples to scale physician-level evaluation of open-ended LLM clinical responses
Comparing frontier LLM-as-a-judge agreement with physicians and with each other
Evaluating LLM diagnostic accuracy when clinical cases are presented piecemeal or token by token

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-as-a-judge system (PrecepTron) and benchmark (GRAND-ROUNDS) for automated evaluation of medical LLM responses, benchmarking against human physician scoring without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
